expo.name: Sirius Star Lab
expo.description: Sirius Star Lab is your personal AI intelligence partner — always thinking, so you can live with clarity. Enjoy streaming conversations, voice I/O, image analysis, smart web search, memory, and daily wisdom. Free to use.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sirius Star Lab uses your microphone to let you speak your messages using voice input.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Sirius Star Lab uses speech recognition to convert your voice into text messages.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sirius Star Lab uses your camera so you can share images directly in your conversations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sirius Star Lab accesses your photo library so you can attach images to your conversations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Sirius Star Lab saves generated images to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sirius Star Lab may use your location to provide localised answers and relevant information.
